headline.en: Hoya Capital report finds 83% of over 200 U.S. REITs raised full-year FFO guidance
headline.zh: Hoya Capital报告：逾200家美国REIT中83%上调全年FFO指引

summary.en: A Hoya Capital report on second-quarter 2026 results found that 83 percent of publicly traded U.S. REITs raised full-year funds from operation guidance, while just 4 percent lowered their outlooks. The data covered more than 200 U.S. REITs and homebuilders; hospitality, industrial and office sectors led the results, though high interest rates and weak investor confidence continue to weigh on the industry.
summary.zh: Hoya Capital一份关于2026年第二季度业绩的报告发现，83%的美国上市REIT上调了全年营运资金（FFO）指引，仅4%下调了展望。数据覆盖逾200家美国REIT和住宅建筑商；酒店、工业和写字楼板块表现领先，但高利率和投资者信心不足仍拖累整个行业。

headline.en: Goldman to acquire LCN Capital Partners for about $260m
headline.zh: 高盛将以约2.6亿美元收购LCN Capital Partners

summary.en: Goldman Sachs has announced it will purchase real estate investment manager LCN Capital Partners for approximately $260m. A further $150m is subject to the achievement of specific long-dated performance targets and service commitments.
summary.zh: 高盛宣布将以约2.6亿美元收购房地产投资管理公司LCN Capital Partners。另有1.5亿美元取决于特定长期业绩目标和服务承诺的达成情况。

headline.en: Andalusian Credit Partners deploys $200m in Q2 2026
headline.zh: Andalusian Credit Partners 于2026年第二季度部署2亿美元

summary.en: US middle market lending platform Andalusian Credit Partners deployed $200m across 22 investments in the second quarter of 2026, its most active quarter to date. Ten of the investments were in new portfolio companies and 12 in existing commitments.
summary.zh: 美国中间市场贷款平台 Andalusian Credit Partners 在2026年第二季度通过22笔投资部署了2亿美元，为其迄今最活跃的季度。其中10笔投资于新组合公司，12笔为现有承诺。
